author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/21_Basic Electrical Engineering Laboratory Viva Questions & Answers -Two Wattmeter（国内版）/src.py

points.K5: 由两表读数算功率因数
points.K6: 三相电源和三相负载举例
points.S1: 功率表反偏：断电后再调换接线
points.S2: 单手操作，身体不靠实验台

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三相实验台前，台上两块功率表和一台小电动机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a three-phase lab bench with two wattmeters with blank dials and a small motor, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 大家好！今天复习二瓦特表法。
overlay: 二瓦特表法：三相功率口试问答

shots.scene: 两块功率表、三相线、电动机三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: two wattmeters, three supply lines, and an induction motor. No people.
shots.narration: 两块表，测出三相总功率。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着一块功率表指针往左打，慌了
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at a wattmeter whose needle swings below zero, looking alarmed.
shots.narration: 做实验时，一块表的指针往反方向偏。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手想直接拔线，小研按住他的手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches to pull a lead off the live meter; the female graduate student holds his hand back.
shots.narration: 他想马上拔线重接，被小研拦住。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 先把口试题过一遍，再说怎么处理。

shots.scene: 三相线路上接着两块功率表的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a three-phase line with two wattmeters connected. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：三相功率怎么测？

shots.scene: 平衡天平和不平衡天平都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a balanced scale and an unbalanced scale, both with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 用二瓦特表法，负载对称不对称都能测。

shots.scene: 两块功率表分别串在两根相线上，第三根线作公共参考
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two wattmeters placed on two of the three lines, with the third line as the common reference. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：两块功率表接在任意两根相线上。

shots.scene: 两块表的读数相加得到总功率
shots.prompt_en: Two meter icons with a plus sign between them and an equals sign leading to a total power icon. No people.
shots.narration: 总功率等于两块表读数相加。

shots.scene: 功率表旁一个有功功率灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: A wattmeter icon beside a glowing lamp icon representing real power. No people.
shots.narration: 测出来的是有功功率。

shots.scene: 白板上写着三相有功功率公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a three-phase real power formula in symbols only. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：有功功率可以用线量写。

shots.scene: 白板上写着用相量表示的公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with the same formula written using phase quantities. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以用相量写，cosφ 是功率因数。

shots.scene: 白板上把 cos 换成 sin
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard where a cosine symbol is replaced by a sine symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 无功功率：把余弦换成正弦。

shots.section_title: 由两表读数算功率因数
shots.scene: 两块表的读数卡片和一个计算器
shots.prompt_en: Two blank reading cards for two meters next to a calculator. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：功率因数怎么算？
overlay: 由两表读数算功率因数

shots.section_title: 由两表读数算功率因数
shots.scene: 白板上写着正切公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a tangent formula in symbols only. No people.
shots.narration: 先由两表读数算出正切值。

shots.section_title: 由两表读数算功率因数
shots.scene: 小研用计算器先求角度，再求余弦
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a calculator, first finding an angle, then its cosine.
shots.narration: 反求出角度，再取余弦，就是功率因数。

shots.section_title: 由两表读数算功率因数
shots.scene: 空白实验指导书翻开
shots.prompt_en: An open lab manual with blank pages. No people.
shots.narration: 两表的先后约定，以指导书为准。

shots.section_title: 三相电源和三相负载举例
shots.scene: 发电机图标引出三根线
shots.prompt_en: A generator icon with three output lines. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：三相电源，比如交流发电机。
overlay: 三相电源和三相负载举例

shots.section_title: 三相电源和三相负载举例
shots.scene: 三相异步电动机图标
shots.prompt_en: A three-phase induction motor icon. No people.
shots.narration: 三相负载，最典型的是异步电动机。

shots.scene: 电动机和发电机图标旁各一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A motor icon and a generator icon, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 口试也可能问电机的原理。

shots.scene: 功率表内部两个线圈示意：一个粗一个细
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a wattmeter showing two coils, one thick and one thin. No people.
shots.narration: 补充：功率表里有两个线圈。

shots.scene: 粗线圈串在线路里
shots.prompt_en: The thick coil connected in series with the line. No people.
shots.narration: 电流线圈串在线路里。

shots.scene: 细线圈并在两根线之间
shots.prompt_en: The thin coil connected across two lines. No people.
shots.narration: 电压线圈并在线路两端。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手，王老师走过来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand and the safety administrator walks over.
shots.narration: 复习有疑问，及时问老师。

shots.section_title: 功率表反偏：断电后再调换接线
shots.scene: 一块功率表指针反偏到零以下的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wattmeter needle deflecting below zero. No people.
shots.narration: 功率因数低时，一块表可能反偏。
overlay: 功率表反偏：断电后再调换接线

shots.section_title: 功率表反偏：断电后再调换接线
shots.scene: 带电拔功率表接线的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand pulling a lead off a live wattmeter, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能带电拔线、换线。

shots.section_title: 功率表反偏：断电后再调换接线
shots.scene: 阿杰拉下电源开关，指示灯熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the three-phase bench power and the indicator lamps go dark.
shots.narration: 先断开电源。

shots.section_title: 功率表反偏：断电后再调换接线
shots.scene: 王老师指导阿杰调换一个线圈的两根接线
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator guides the young male student as he swaps the two leads of one meter coil.
shots.narration: 在老师指导下调换线圈接线。

shots.section_title: 功率表反偏：断电后再调换接线
shots.scene: 空白记录表上一格画着负号图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank record table with a minus sign icon in one cell. No people.
shots.narration: 老师查过再通电，读数记为负值。

shots.section_title: 单手操作，身体不靠实验台
shots.scene: 阿杰一只手调节旋钮，另一只手放在背后
shots.prompt_en: The young male student adjusts a knob with one hand while keeping his other hand behind his back.
shots.narration: 通电后调节、读数，尽量单手操作。
overlay: 单手操作，身体不靠实验台

shots.section_title: 单手操作，身体不靠实验台
shots.scene: 双手同时抓住两根导线的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two hands each gripping a different lead at the same time, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别两只手同时碰两处导体。

shots.section_title: 单手操作，身体不靠实验台
shots.scene: 人趴在实验台上看表的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaning their body on a powered lab bench to read a meter, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 读表时身体别靠在实验台上。

shots.scene: 当心触电警示标志贴在配电箱上
shots.prompt_en: An electrical hazard warning sign on a distribution box. No people.
shots.narration: 黄色三角闪电：当心触电。

shots.scene: 开关上挂着禁止合闸的禁止标志牌
shots.prompt_en: A prohibition sign tag for do not switch on hanging on a switch. No people.
shots.narration: 挂着禁止合闸牌，谁也不能合闸。

shots.scene: 接地标志贴在实验台接地端子旁
shots.prompt_en: A protective earth symbol label beside the earth terminal of a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 接地标志处，接地线不能拆。

shots.scene: 阿杰进门前停下，看墙上的标志
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pauses at the lab door to look at the safety signs on the wall.
shots.narration: 进门先看标志，按标志要求做。

shots.scene: 实验台上散落着螺丝刀、多余导线和水杯
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench cluttered with a screwdriver, spare leads and a cup. No people.
shots.narration: 通电前，看看台面乱不乱。

shots.scene: 阿杰把多余导线和工具收进盒子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts spare leads and tools away into a box.
shots.narration: 多余导线和工具，全部收走。

shots.scene: 台面整洁，只剩接好的线路，阿杰喊一声后合闸
shots.prompt_en: A tidy bench with only the finished circuit; the young male student calls out a warning before switching on.
shots.narration: 台面干净了，再请老师检查通电。

shots.scene: 两块功率表相加的图标
shots.prompt_en: Two wattmeter icons with a plus sign and an equals sign. No people.
shots.narration: 二瓦特表法：两表相加是总功率。

shots.scene: 余弦和正弦两张公式卡片
shots.prompt_en: Two formula cards, one with a cosine symbol and one with a sine symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 有功用余弦，无功用正弦。

shots.scene: 发电机和电动机图标
shots.prompt_en: A generator icon and a motor icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 电源如发电机，负载如电动机。

shots.scene: 反偏指针、断开的开关、单手、警示标志四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a reversed meter needle, a switched-off switch, a single hand, and an electrical hazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 反偏先断电，单手操作，认清标志。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁、已断电的三相实验台前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at a tidy, switched-off three-phase lab bench.
shots.narration: 祝口试顺利，安全用电！
